title: The government sued $124,700 in cash
voice_lines: [curious] A cooler lid lifts on a Nebraska highway.
Inside: seven bundles, wrapped in foil.
One hundred twenty-four thousand, seven hundred dollars.
[serious] The driver had said: no cash.
A drug dog alerts. No drugs are found.
No drug charges. [short pause] The government sues the money.
He says three people pooled it for a produce truck.
A judge rules for him. [short pause] The appeals court reverses.
[serious] He was never the defendant. The cash was, the moment
